question: What amplitude-free directional and load-response restrictions follow from the equal-mode passive first-star graphite null?

objects.definition: g_N=4pi sqrt(N)/(sqrt3 a), tau=eta/kappa; speed v>0
objects.coefficient_domain: Q(x) for algebra; physical inputs real
objects.basis_orientation: Euclidean first-star reference axis at phi=0
objects.origin: assumed equal Debye bath plus published first-star geometry

objects.definition: P=-F_d.v, phi0 axis and phi30 rotated, matched contact/readout; C>0
objects.metric_measure: phase/cycle average; same speed and pressure

sources.source_status: published first-principles rigid PES, not friction trace

sources.section_or_object_id: paired friction peaks, negligible load dependence; no force tables accessible

assumptions: Equal independent q_j with positive kappa,eta and nonzero coupling; the resulting C>0 cancels
Same contact atom count, instrument transfer, speed, pressure and star-axis registration across directions
Direction ratio is for dissipated power, not total friction trace; fixed transverse conservative force omitted
Cross-index collapse additionally assumes common tau and contact/readout across N7,N13

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: rational squared direction cosines at 0 and 30 degrees

technique_plan.technique: integer polynomial identities and derivative sign

technique_plan.purpose_or_na_reason: identify canceled amplitude, retained tau and load scale
no new UD carrier, topology or native clock; this is a conventional dynamic control

clock_receipt.clock_type: continuous physical time in assumed bath; UD native clock N/A
clock_receipt.physical_unit_map: tau=eta/kappa time, g inverse length, v length/time

dynamics_readout.state_space: three real q_j driven by prescribed 2D r(t)
dynamics_readout.generator_or_update: three passive first-order relaxers with tau
dynamics_readout.initial_boundary_conditions: steady state under constant v, phase average; phi relative reciprocal star
dynamics_readout.projection_and_kernel: phi30 has one stationary first-star mode contributing zero dissipated power
dynamics_readout.physical_mapping: per-atom power to observed contact force OPEN

target_exposure.status: known PRL peaks; derivation is development and conventional null
fitted_parameters_or_formula_choices: equal-channel bath is assumed; no source coefficient or tau fit
target_exposure.search_domain_and_budget: single prior three-wave equal-mode model; no parameter search

calculation_steps: At phi0 use squared cosines (1,1/4,1/4): f0=1/(1+x)+2/(4+x).
Differentiate: N_prime D-N D_prime=x(8+5x), proving R_prime>0 for x>0.
Since x=g²v²tau², at fixed v: d_P ln R=2K(d_P ln g+d_P ln tau). Under common tau, g13/g7=sqrt(13/7).
Invert R=r: (3-2r)x²-10(r-1)x-8(r-1)=0; R monotonic gives a unique nonnegative root for 1<=r<3/2; at x=1 d ln tau/dr=1/(2x R_prime)=100/13.

result.approximation: at x=1 ratio=1.05; at x=4 ratio=1.20
result.units: dimensionless ratio and logarithmic pressure slope per pressure unit
result.precision_and_error: exact rational model; no measured uncertainty or physical speed because tau unknown; 0.01 absolute ratio error illustrates about 7.7% linearized tau error at x=1, excluding systematics
result.scope: amplitude-free within equal-mode conventional bath and matched contact/readout, not a universal graphite inequality
result.physical_interpretation: conditional conventional null only; UD residual OPEN

verification.method: integer-polynomial identity and independent rational-angle sum samples

counterexamples_and_failures: C=0 makes physical ratio 0/0; x=0 endpoint is limiting positive-C model
unequal tau or direction-dependent contact breaks amplitude-free shape
same sixfold symmetry possible from other conventional or UD mechanisms; null failure cannot attribute UD
limitations: no experimental directional force and threshold through accessible PRL abstract
line scan PES does not certify transverse Hessian or contact geometry
mode mixing, edges, stick-slip and finite-window phase effects excluded
independent physics review NOT_RUN; physical promotion 0
changed_dependencies: no alteration of paper v2 or previous source results
next_discriminant: registered direction/velocity sweep with contact control, independent tau linewidth and held-out pressure/speed points; N13 if detector allows
